verdict.rationale: Mailchimp documents public REST APIs at a published root (GET https://api.mailchimp.com/3.0/). The Marketing API covers creating contacts, sending campaigns and account exports, and the Transactional API covers SMS, routing and allowlists, so a programmatic agent can drive core product actions. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of API use, and evidence of auth and rate-limit documentation.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API

citations.quote: The API root resource links to all other resources available in the API.
Create a new omni-channel contact for an audience.
